newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - July 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Wednesday:
* The Dow hit its 32nd record close of the year and its first close ever above 7,900.
* Motorola announced second quarter results that modestly exceeded analysts estimations.
* Tougher lending standards at banks and cutbacks by consumers pushed borrowing by Americans higher in May.
* International Paper Co said it would sell $1 billion in assets and cut 9,000 jobs.
* An Agricultural Department report said a poor coffee crop in Colombia would keep world supplies tight.
* The dollar rose to a three-and-a-half year high against the German mark.
* Jitney-Jungle Stores of America plans to acquire Delchamps.
* A study finds that those who travel to foreign countries for business filed health insurance claims at a greater rate than stay-at-homes.
* ING Groep N.V. agrees to buy Equitable of Iowa Cos for $2.2 billion in cash and stock.
* Montgomery Ward'd Chapter 11 filing underscores how different American retailing is from just five years ago when R.H. Macy and Co filed.
* The Clinton administration is redefining the "commercial diplomacy" as practiced by the late Commerce Secretary Ron Brown.
